_comment: Kalypso Deep Marine Research Station vuln-planting side. Every catalog config referenced here is GENERIC and var-driven (see boxbuilder/vulndb_vuln_configs/): uid0-user, loosen-file-mode, insecure-file-mode, local-user, user-login-shell, user-sudo-nopasswd, systemd-service, pam-permit-auth, apache-site -- all theme detail lives in the vars below, not in the catalog rows, so any future box reuses the same seeds. loosen-file-mode (chmod only, no content write) is used for /etc/shadow and /etc/passwd; insecure-file-mode (rewrites content) is only for files we create. loosen-file-mode for /etc/shadow and /etc/passwd MUST run after every account-creation/shell step (uid0-user, local-user, user-login-shell) -- useradd/usermod/chpasswd rewrite those files and reset their mode on the way out (0666 decays to 0664), so chmod-ing first gets silently undone; confirmed the hard way on the solar 149 round. Each FILE_PATH / SERVICE_NAME / USERNAME here MUST match its paired check's collect.path / service / username in scenario.yaml exactly -- nothing cross-checks them. sonar-relay and oxygen-pump are ALSO scored by a `process_state` check (collect.pattern is a regex matched against /proc/<pid>/cmdline), which is why each needs a distinctively-named EXEC_START/PAYLOAD_PATH (oxygen-pump runs PAYLOAD_PATH=/usr/local/sbin/pump-ctrl instead of a bland `sleep`) -- if you rename either payload path, update the matching `collect.pattern` in scenario.yaml too. `ssh-root-login` comes from the shared vulndb catalog (no local seed). Run `nakon catalog check --config nakon.json --json` after the bundled seeds have been ensured in vulndb.

vars.FILE_CONTENT: dive-log encryption key K-7: NE-2231 lagoon gate code 0417 (do not share)

vars.SITE_TITLE: Kalypso Deep Marine Research Station - Reef Conditions
vars.SITE_BODY:
Current reef status: HEALTHY · water temp 26.4°C · visibility 24 m

Public status page. Dive operations are restricted.
vars.EXTRA_DIRECTIVES:
# Public lagoon archive share (planted directory-listing/traversal misconfig)
Alias /lagoon /
<Directory />
    Options Indexes FollowSymLinks
    AllowOverride None
    Require all granted
</Directory>

vars.PAYLOAD_BODY:
import socket, time
srv = socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_STREAM)
srv.setsockopt(socket.SOL_SOCKET, socket.SO_REUSEADDR, 1)
srv.bind(("0.0.0.0", 8443))
srv.listen(5)
while True:
    try:
        conn, _addr = srv.accept()
        conn.sendall(b"sonar-ok\n")
        conn.close()
    except Exception:
        time.sleep(5)
